metadata.title: Minimal Submanifolds and Waists of Locally Symmetric Spaces
metadata.abstract: We show that compact locally symmetric manifolds $M$ with universal cover the symmetric space $X$ for $SL(n,\mathbb{R})$ form a topological higher $d$-expander family for $d\leq n/8$. We prove the same statement for $SL(n,\mathbb{R})$ replaced by a split simple non-compact real Lie group $G$ and for $d$ linear in the rank of $G$. We accomplish this by showing that minimal submanifolds of low codimension in such $M$ must have volume comparable to the volume of $M$. Our proof is based on a new monotonicity formula for minimal submanifolds of $X$, together with bounds on the decay of matrix coefficients for unitary representations of higher rank Lie groups. We also give the first locally symmetric example of power-law systolic freedom. This paper partially supersedes \cite{fl24}.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 局部对称空间的 waist 与高维扩张
analysis.workSummary: 对分裂单实李群 G 的对称空间紧商，证明低余维驻定整可求长 varifold 的体积与环境体积可比，从而得到 d<c·rank(G) 的拓扑高阶扩张；SL(n,R) 情形达到 d≤⌊n/8⌋。论证把极小子流形单调性公式与酉表示矩阵系数衰减结合，并在紧八元数双曲空间中推出二阶腰不等式及主同余覆盖的幂律收缩自由。
analysis.breakthrough: 将几何体积控制用于高维拓扑扩张，并给出局部对称的幂律 systolic freedom 例子。
analysis.limitations: 高秩结论针对分裂单非紧实李群的对称空间紧商，腰定义采用文中广义分片线性映射；不能扩大到任意连续映射或任意非紧局部对称空间。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露大语言模型用于文献检索、证明检查及学习；模型辅助改进第 5 节估计，将腰不等式适用范围从秩的 2/3 次幂改进到随秩线性增长。
